introduction: Annie McCormick has already established herself as a talented young actress with an impressive resume.Beginning her acting career as a baby, Annie has grown up in the spotlight, sharing the stage and screen with her twin sister, Maggie McCormick. Together, the dynamic duo has captivated audiences in various film and television projects.Notable credits include "Welcome to Derry" and "The Institute", showcasing Annie's versatility and natural talent.With a bright future ahead, Annie continues to pursue her passion for acting, inspiring audiences with her charm and dedication to her craft.
